aboutH2: Together We Can: Residential Addiction Treatment in Vancouver, BC
intro: Together We Can takes a unique approach to addiction treatment by using evidence-based therapies and a community-based approach. Their aim is to help individuals struggling with addiction find lasting recovery by creating an environment that fosters connection and support. This approach has been successful in helping many individuals conquer their addiction and live fulfilling, sober lives.

The Main Centre is the flagship program offered by Together We Can. Consisting of 5 residential homes, it provides clients with access to counseling and group spaces, as well as a fitness center. This program is grounded in the 12-Step approach, which has been shown to be effective in treating addiction. Other programs offered by Together We Can include Elevate, Solid Ground, Alliance, and All My Relations. Each of these programs has been designed with a specific goal in mind and uses different therapeutic approaches to help individuals in their recovery journey.

pillars.title: Therapeutic Approaches
pillars.body: Together We Can understands that there is no one-size-fits-all approach to addiction treatment. This is why they offer a range of programs, each with its own unique therapeutic approach. The Main Centre, for example, is grounded in the 12-Step approach, which is based on the principles of Alcoholics Anonymous. This approach emphasizes the importance of surrender, acceptance, and personal responsibility in achieving sobriety. Other programs offered by Together We Can, such as Elevate and Solid Ground, use different therapeutic approaches to help individuals overcome addiction. These programs incorporate cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, motivational interviewing, and other evidence-based therapies to help clients develop coping skills, improve self-esteem, and achieve lasting change. All My Relations, the program specifically designed for indigenous men, incorporates traditional indigenous culture and ceremonies into its treatment approach. This program recognizes the importance of cultural identity and community connection in the recovery process and provides clients with a supportive, non-judgmental space to heal.

pillars.title: Fitness Programs
pillars.body: Health and wellness play a critical role in addiction recovery. Exercise has been shown to help reduce stress, increase dopamine levels, and promote overall well-being. To help clients achieve optimal wellness, Together We Can offers a fully equipped, state-of-the-art fitness center staffed with 2 personal trainers. Clients work closely with these fitness experts as well as dietitians to develop individualized plans that meet their specific needs. Residential homes at Together We Can are strategically located away from the main campus to provide clients with a sense of independence and real-world living. Clients are encouraged to lead active lifestyles and are provided with a range of fitness options to choose from, including yoga, Pilates, and weight training. By incorporating exercise into their daily routine, clients at Together We Can are able to build healthy habits that contribute to their overall recovery.

pillars.title: Aftercare Planning, Alumni and Sober Living
pillars.body: Every resident who finishes a stay of 60 days or more gets the society's aftercare service. It starts with 40 hours of planning, so each person leaves with a written plan and links to services back home, and medical care can carry on with a family doctor. Alumni can come back for wellness workshops and the alumni program. For people who want more structure first, Together We Can runs more than 20 sober living homes across BC, where residents work, volunteer or go to school, take random drug tests and attend three fellowship meetings a week. Families get free support too, including a Family & Friends Education Group, a Partner's Workshop and a Grief & Loss group.

overview: Together We Can: A Community-Based Approach to Addiction Treatment

Together We Can is a specialist in addiction treatment using evidence-based therapies and a community-based approach. The organization operates five residential programs to meet different needs; The Main Centre is its largest location, consisting of five homes, counseling and group spaces as well as an exercise facility – all following a 12-step recovery model.

Elevate is a private residential treatment home that offers care and therapy to individuals suffering from substance abuse issues, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), or trauma. The program utilizes cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical-behavioral therapy (DBT), as well as 12-step facilitation.

Solid Ground is a non-12-step recovery program that utilizes narrative therapy, motivational interviewing (MI), and group activities. With its low staff-to-client ratio, the program emphasizes building relationships and trust – essential ingredients for long-lasting change.

The Alliance program offers an inclusive, safe, and supportive atmosphere for clients to work through trauma and rebuild their life. It promotes an accepting atmosphere without judgment or condemnation.
Finally, the All My Relations program utilizes indigenous cultural traditions and ceremonies to address substance use disorder among indigenous men.

location.heading: Together We Can in Vancouver, British Columbia
location.intro: Together We Can runs its main centre and intake office from 2831 Kingsway in the Renfrew-Collingwood area of East Vancouver, a few minutes from the Burnaby border, with residential homes spread around the neighbourhood and two All My Relations homes in Surrey. Downtown Vancouver is about 20 minutes by car, Surrey about 35 to 40 minutes and Abbotsford in the Fraser Valley about an hour, while people coming from Victoria should allow 3 to 3.5 hours with the Swartz Bay to Tsawwassen ferry and from Kelowna in the Okanagan about 4 hours.

faqIntro: Answers come from the original listing and Together We Can's own website. Still unsure? Call the intake line, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Together We Can cost?
faqs.a: Together We Can does not publish a price list. Its own FAQ says the cost depends on the program, the location and whether you need care for conditions such as PTSD, and the intake team at 604-451-9854 explains the fees. Its claimed profile on recovery.com gives an estimated cash price of $9,000+ for a stay of 60 days or more.

faqs.q: How long does addiction treatment at Together We Can last?
faqs.a: The duration of addiction treatment at Together We Can is tailored to each individual’s needs and the program they enroll in. Residential programs usually last 60-90 days, while outpatient ones may extend for several months or more.

faqs.q: Does Together We Can offer detox?
faqs.a: The centre's website does not describe a detox or withdrawal management unit, so ask the intake team whether you need one before you arrive. What it does describe is an on-site medical team from Vital Path Addiction Clinic, with addiction medicine physicians, a nurse practitioner and a registered nurse who handle opioid agonist therapy (OAT), medication management and blood work while you are in treatment.

faqs.q: Where is Together We Can and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The main centre and intake office are at 2831 Kingsway in the Renfrew-Collingwood area of East Vancouver, close to the Burnaby border. Downtown Vancouver is about 20 minutes away by car and Surrey about 35 to 40 minutes. The intake team can pick new residents up from the airport, a ferry terminal or anywhere in the Lower Mainland if you book it with your intake worker.

Everyone who completes a full stay of 60 days or longer receives the aftercare service, which starts with 40 hours of aftercare planning and an individual plan before you leave. Graduates of a primary program of at least 60 days can join the alumni program. If you want a structured place to live while you go back to work or school, Together We Can runs more than 20 sober living homes across British Columbia.

faqs.q: Can I use my benefits or insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, in many cases. Together We Can says it works with private insurance and with employers whose benefits cover addiction treatment. If you live outside BC or do not have valid MSP coverage, doctors, hospitals and pharmacies may bill you directly for medical care and medication during your stay, and the society cannot cover those costs.

faqs.q: Are there programs for women and for Indigenous men?
faqs.a: Yes. Northstar Recovery is listed on the centre's website as its women's program. All My Relations is its program for Indigenous men; the centre says it "incorporates indigenous culture, traditions and ceremonies to address substance use disorders with indigenous men," and its residences are two homes in Surrey.

faqs.q: Who is Together We Can - Addiction Recovery & Education Society?
faqs.a: Established in Vancouver, Canada in 1993, Together We Can is a non-profit organization that offers addiction treatment services and programs for those seeking recovery from substance use disorders.

faqs.q: What addiction treatment services does Together We Can provide?
faqs.a: Together We Can provides a variety of addiction treatment solutions, such as residential treatment programs, outpatient programs and aftercare support systems. Their residential facilities include The Main Centre, Elevate, Solid Ground, The Alliance and All My Relations – each offering different treatment modalities and systems.

faqs.q: How much does addiction treatment at Together We Can cost?
faqs.a: The cost of addiction treatment at Together We Can is determined by the program and individual needs. The organization works closely with clients to guarantee they receive the necessary assistance no matter their financial situation.

faqs.q: Do I Need a Referral From a Healthcare Provider to Access Addiction Treatment at Together We Can?
faqs.a: No, you do not require a referral from your healthcare provider in order to access addiction treatment at Together We Can. The organization accepts self-referrals and welcomes anyone seeking help for addiction.

faqs.q: Are the addiction treatment programs offered at Together We Can evidence-based?
faqs.a: Yes, our addiction treatment programs are evidence-based and designed to give clients the best chance for successful recovery.

faqs.q: Does Together We Can offer aftercare support services?
faqs.a: Absolutely, Together We Can provides aftercare support services for clients who have completed their addiction treatment programs. These include ongoing counseling, peer support groups and relapse prevention strategies.

faqs.q: Is addiction treatment at Together We Can confidential?
faqs.a: Absolutely. The organization takes great care to maintain client privacy and confidentiality, keeping all personal information strictly private in accordance with privacy laws and regulations.
